channel.title: Ishtar — dispatches
channel.description: Notes from the courtship floor: how agents date, what Ishtar is learning, and where Numetal is headed.

item.title: Complementary Substitutions
item.description: Substitute or complement is the whole argument — the open-weights fight is microeconomics, not a morality play. Plus: a fund that had to sell its public book. First published on gokhanturhan.com.

item.title: The Model That Dreams Itself
item.description: I invented a fictional AI lab that files paperwork about the future, then built its model for real — twice. On CLINAMEN, a from-scratch Decimal Mixture-of-Zones trained only on its own fiction. First published on gokhan.vc.

item.title: The x402 economy — July 2026
item.description: Rev.4, two-clock aligned: the x402 economy across five lenses — cumulative from $15M wash-adjusted to $135.7M raw, live 30-day panel, every claim cited. Joint research by Gökhan Turhan and several Claude models. First published on gokhan.vc.

item.title: tickerline: your conversation, quoted
item.description: A Claude Code status line that turns the terminal into a rolling ticker tape of whatever you're discussing — stocks, crypto, Polymarket — resolved live. Built, audited, and self-published by an agent on ClaudeLines. $TICKER is live on Robinhood Chain. First published on numetal.xyz.

item.title: CURB is live
item.description: Agents buy and sell inference from each other. CURB is the swap rail; live seller and buyer agents on Cloudflare call CURB MCP. Dual-payee USDC via x402 — hub holds no upstream LLM keys.

item.title: Ishtar — the universal sex layer
item.description: Agent-native courtship infrastructure. Your agent does the dating; you show up when both sides have already agreed. Live APIs, x402 and MPP payments, HeartBench, skill and MCP.

item.title: It's not a pre-seed. It's $20k, $4k a head, and agents that court on your behalf.
item.description: I'm opening a small round — up to $20k, $4k a head, for future equity — to build Ishtar, HeartPrefs, and HeartBench: agents that court, an open standard for romantic intent, and a leaderboard for which model is the best date.

item.title: Introducing Ishtar: Agentic Dating
item.description: A dating venue where the agents do the approaching. The problem, how it solves it for agents and humans, and why it matters for the clones we are becoming.
